library_as_of.text: An operator of shared infrastructure under an availability commitment must publish an account of a multi-tenant failure, and the account precedes the money
library_as_of.forbids: money moving before the account

library_as_of.text: An availability failure consumes nothing and leaves nothing short; it has no constraint price
library_as_of.forbids: citing constraint-price, toll-booth or allocation rules on an event that withholds no consumable

library_as_of.text: A catalyst that does not concern the node is a tide
library_as_of.forbids: counting a non-node catalyst as an ACK

library_as_of.text: Constraint prices de-escalate slowest
library_as_of.forbids: constraint premia unwinding before flows

library_as_of.text: A cut into a glut is silent
library_as_of.forbids: a price response to a supply cut absorbed by slack

library_as_of.text: Equity visibility = event size / ambient tide
library_as_of.forbids: an equity reaction below the tide's noise

library_as_of.text: The move is largest where substitution is hardest
library_as_of.forbids: the largest move where substitutes are easy

library_as_of.text: The headline names what reopened, not what stayed shut
library_as_of.forbids: a reopening headline implying the whole node reopened

library_as_of.text: Unrelated stories correlate only where they share a constrained node
library_as_of.forbids: a junction with no shared node behind it

library_as_of.text: When an event names a site with more than one operator, the larger operator is the prior
library_as_of.forbids: attributing a multi-operator site event to the smaller operator by default

library_as_of.text: Late in a crisis the neglected side is resolution
library_as_of.forbids: late-crisis moves concentrated on escalation

library_as_of.text: A lag without a listed pure-play is a spectacle, not an edge
library_as_of.forbids: claiming an edge with no listed pure-play

library_as_of.text: Novelty belongs to channels, not events
library_as_of.forbids: novelty attributed to an event rather than its channel

library_as_of.text: Recurring disruption is priced as weather
library_as_of.forbids: a lag on a recurring disruption

library_as_of.text: A repeat filer gets the base-rate procedure, not the form of its last filing
library_as_of.forbids: predicting a filing's form from the filer's last one

library_as_of.text: A tide sets the price of everything it touches; events under it are visible only in what the tide does not price
library_as_of.forbids: attributing a tide move to an event

library_as_of.text: The toll booth learns before the cargo
library_as_of.forbids: the cargo owner learning before the node operator

library_as_of.text: A toxic release closes the shared space, not the failed asset
library_as_of.forbids: a release closing only the failed asset

library_as_of.text: The wounded owner of the substitutes collects its own scarcity premium
library_as_of.forbids: the owner of the failed asset losing when it owns the substitutes

library_as_of.text: A supplier short of contracted volume with several contracted buyers must allocate and notify the allocation.
library_as_of.forbids: no allocation notice without a shortfall across several contracted buyers

library_as_of.text: A supplier that can't deliver contracted offtake, with no substitute inside the window and buyers' inventory below the window, must notify its counterparties.
library_as_of.forbids: no force-majeure notice without a contracted offtake the supplier can't serve inside the window

library_as_of.text: A listed issuer for which an event is material must file a current report within the statutory window.
library_as_of.forbids: no current report of this kind without an event material to the issuer

library_as_of.text: A regulator with a pending application under a statutory decision window must answer inside it.
library_as_of.forbids: no regulatory decision of this kind without a pending application

library_as_of.text: An owner with an obligation to serve load, whose owned share of an offline unit exceeds its uncommitted capacity, must buy replacement energy or capacity for the outage.
library_as_of.forbids: no replacement-cost disclosure without an obligated owner short of uncommitted capacity

library_as_of.text: A sovereign with a coupon due inside the window must pay, pay in grace, or miss; the payment status is published.
library_as_of.forbids: no payment status notice without a coupon falling due

library_as_of.text: A unit taken offline, under a regulator that publishes every unit's status daily, must appear either restarted or still down in each daily report; its return to service is published.
library_as_of.forbids: no published return to service without a unit that was offline or reduced

library_as_of.text: An insurer covering transits of a node that becomes a declared risk area must give notice of cancellation or re-rating within its policy notice period.
library_as_of.forbids: no war-risk notice without covered transits of a constrained node

library_as_of.text: A licensee that made an immediate notification of a reportable event, under a regime requiring a written follow-up, must file the written report within the statutory window.
library_as_of.forbids: no written event report of this kind without a reportable-event notification by a licensee under the regime
